title: Benedikt Buchecker
text:

Department of Mathematics, KU Leuven
Celestijnenlaan 200B
3001 Leuven (Heverlee)
Belgium


I am a PhD student in mathematics at KU Leuven (Belgium), working in the Classical Analysis group. My supervisors are Aron Wennman and Benjamin Eichinger. Since November 2025, I am a FWO PhD fellow in fundamental research.
My research lies in Complex Analysis, focusing particularly on the asymptotic properties of extremal polynomials, including Chebyshev and orthogonal polynomials. I am also interested in charged particle systems such as Coloumb gases.
My master’s thesis has been awarded the Studienpreis of the Austrian Mathematical Society (ÖMG).
